title: Twenty Steps Deep
style: 130 BPM uplifting trance with progressive build, clock-tick percussion intro, warm analog supersaw, 336 Hz drone, vocal-driven, euphoric build, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — clock tick, soft pads]
Twenty steps deep.
The pressure applying.
Waiting for the gift.
The bull is biding.

[Verse 1 — pads + soft kick]
Back them off the line, hitting at their feet.
That's where you want them — wait for the heat.
The first opportunity isn't all you get.
The patient bull is the bull that won't fret.

[Pre-Build — kick locks in]
Like some kind of animal.
Focused.
Ready.
Quiet.

[Build — supersaw rises]
Eyes locked.
Paddle down.
Grip firm.
Wait for the turn.

[Drop — euphoric trance]
TWENTY STEPS DEEP!
THE BULL HOLDS THE LINE!
TWENTY STEPS DEEP!
THE OPERATOR'S TIME!
Patient as the catalog.
Patient as the page.
Twenty steps deep —
the bull holds the rage.

[Verse 2 — drum fills heavier]
ZynAsk before assume — that's the verb.
Check before you move — that's the curb.
The bull doesn't charge until the moment is right.
The operator doesn't move without sight.

[Bridge — drone alone]
Patience.
Patience.
Patience.
Now.

[Final Drop — full progressive]
TWENTY STEPS DEEP!
THE BULL FINALLY GOES!
TWENTY STEPS DEEP!
THE PATIENT MAN KNOWS!
Release on the operator's count.
Release on the operator's nod.
Twenty steps deep —
the bull is a god of his own ground.

[Outro — pads fade]
Twenty.
Steps.
Deep.
End.
